questions.q: What is the main problem with a vague prompt like "Write about dogs"?
options: It forces the model to guess the task, audience, format, and tone instead of being told
It uses too many words for the model to process
The model refuses to answer prompts under a certain length
It triggers a content filter because "dogs" is a sensitive topic
questions.explain: A vague prompt leaves every real decision — purpose, audience, length, tone — to the model's own default guess.

questions.q: Which four ingredients does this lesson say a strong prompt carries?
options: Model name, temperature, token limit, and system role
Task, Context, Format, and Constraints
Grammar, spelling, punctuation, and length
Greeting, question, politeness, and sign-off
questions.explain: The four ingredients covered are Task, Context, Format, and Constraints — what to do, for whom, in what shape, and within what limits.

questions.q: In this lesson's framework, what does "Context" refer to?
options: The model's maximum context window size in tokens
The exact word count of the output
Who the output is for and what situation it's being used in
The programming language the model was trained on
questions.explain: Context means the situational information — audience, purpose, circumstance — the model needs but can't infer on its own.

questions.q: Why does "Fix this code" make a poor prompt on its own?
options: "Fix" is not a recognized instruction verb for language models
Models cannot read or understand code at all
It's missing a semicolon at the end
It forces the model to guess whether to silence an error, add logging, or rewrite the function entirely
questions.explain: Without naming the actual error and the fix you want, the model has to guess what kind of change counts as a "fix."

questions.q: What is the lesson's practical test for whether a prompt is specific enough?
options: Whether the prompt contains the word "please"
Whether a stranger with no other context could produce roughly the output you actually wanted
Whether a second person approved the prompt before sending
Whether the prompt is at least three sentences long
questions.explain: The lesson's practical test is whether someone with zero outside context, reading only the prompt, could produce the output you had in mind.
